request.spec:
A pool membership may carry a from-date and a to-date (optional; a to-date before the from-date
is refused; POOL_MEMBER_ADDED gains from=<date> and to=<date> at the end when given). A member whose
dates do not include the sheet's today is left out entirely: not in the total share, not in the
balance, no cut.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A pool membership may carry a from-date and a to-date (optional; a to-date before the from-date
is refused; POOL_MEMBER_ADDED gains from=<date> and to=<date> at the end when given). A member whose
dates do not include the sheet's today is left out entirely: not in the total share, not in the
balance, no cut.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Pool memberships can now have an optional from-date and to-date, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V64__pool_member_dates.sql`, adds a nullable from-date and to-date to each pool membership. A blank date means no limit on that side. I didn't default a blank from-date to the sheet's today, because the expected audit line for Cam has no `from=`.
- **Adding a member:** each date must be blank or `yyyy-MM-dd`. A to-date before the from-date is refused, so nothing is stored or audited and the pool's error shows. `POOL_MEMBER_ADDED` ends with ` from=<date>` and ` to=<date>` only when they were given.
- **Totals and cuts:** a member whose dates don't include the sheet's today counts for nothing in the pool's total share or its balance, and gets no cut. Their cut shows blank rather than `0.00`. A member that is itself a pool follows the same rule, so when it's out of range the people inside it get no cut either.
- **Screen:** the pool row has `pool-member-from` and `pool-member-to` inputs. Each member line shows its dates when it has any, plus "(not in force)" when today is outside them.

Two things I didn't change:
- When two people are merged, the memberships of the person merged away keep their dates. If both people were in the same pool, the shares are added and only the surviving person's dates are kept.
- The response to adding a member always marks it as in force, even if its dates don't include today. The screen re-reads the pools straight afterwards, so this never shows up wrong.
